title: I massively improved my matched engine! What do you think?
author: AcrobaticHoney6780
selftext: I have been working on improving the match engine for a long time (still some minor improvements possible), but what do you think? (The low fps is because of the recording tool, the game actually runs smoother)

comments.author: DrawingClean949
comments.body: gameplay looks really good. there's a lot of text on the ui- could any of it be hidden during a match?

replies.author: AcrobaticHoney6780
replies.body: I see your point! Do you mean for example having the option to just have the match without the stats and comments? Or do you mean the UI on top?

comments.author: Patient-Committee588
comments.body: Oh yeah it's going to be over for Football Manager soon lol, this looks really good

replies.author: AcrobaticHoney6780
replies.body: Thank you so much! It means a lot!

comments.author: TopTippityTop
comments.body: They could use some acceleration, inertia

replies.author: AcrobaticHoney6780
replies.body: Mmmm that is an interesting point! Maybe I try it out! Thank you!

replies.author: ichisay
replies.body: Dices motor de emparejamiento, a qué te refieres???

replies.author: AcrobaticHoney6780
replies.body: Ah, la traduccion literal debio de saltar, puse match engine en ingles, la traduccion real es motor de partido! He mejorado el motor de partido, haciendo que se pueda influir mas, se vea mas fluido y estetico!

replies.author: ichisay
replies.body: Entiendo, también suponía que mi traducción estuviera mal, por eso preguntaba, fallo mío no verlo en inglés, hubiera entendido y me ahorraría preguntarte jajajaja

replies.author: AcrobaticHoney6780
replies.body: Jajajja ningun problema! Por suerte el juego estara traducido a muchos idiomas!
